root_cause: The recovery flow was export-only and lacked a canonical package format with integrity checking, version gating, duplicate resolution, and progress UI, so imported ZIPs silently failed or produced inconsistent state.
fix_pattern: Defined a manifest-driven package format (manifest.json + SHA-256 + size + schemaVersion/minReaderVersion). Added a resilient reader with path-traversal guard and LocalizedError taxonomy, a writer with 16 MiB log cap and encryption metadata, replace/merge/skip duplicate resolution in ChatViewModel, and a determinate progress overlay in ChatPanelView.
lessons: Sanitize every touched canon file for ASCII-only after any edit; non-ASCII in pre-existing content is re-flagged when the file is modified.
Check whether persistence methods are throwing before adding do/catch rollback logic; unreachable catch blocks produce build warnings and mislead reviewers.
Start the BrowserOS server before running clade-e2e; a rebuilt app does not restart the server.
A first-class recovery reader should verify every manifest entry (size + SHA-256) before trusting extracted contents.
